title: Implement Gate 0 Codespace Evidence Bridge
purpose: Implement the bounded Gate 0 bridge that collects exact-SHA GitHub and local execution evidence, seals it, publishes it only to its verified GitHub origin, and optionally stops the exact Codespace after verified durable publication.
invariants: All subprocesses use explicit argv and shell=False.
No request can provide a command, argv, shell fragment, script, plugin, path or environment override.
Every target SHA is a full lowercase 40-character SHA and is checked before execution and again before publication.
Local operations execute only in a disposable clone detached at the exact requested SHA.
The primary checkout remains byte-for-byte equivalent in recorded HEAD, status, refs, index and remotes facts.
The request is bound by marker and canonical request digest to one exact GitHub issue or pull-request conversation comment.
Publication can target only that verified same-origin issue-conversation object.
Paginated GitHub inventories are exhausted and incomplete evidence is explicit.
The evidence bundle is sealed before publication and publication receipts remain separate.
The exact posted comment is read back by returned comment ID and verified byte-for-byte.
One publication is limited to 58000 UTF-8 bytes and partial evidence cannot appear final.
Tokens, secrets, cookies, credentials and authorization material are redacted from local and durable evidence.
Retries allocate immutable attempt directories without overwriting earlier attempts.
Self-stop is possible only after verified durable publication and exact Codespace identity validation.
The ordinary runner cannot classify an outcome as GOVERNANCE_DECISION.
requiredEvidence: Exact baseline, merge base, branch and head are reported.
The complete diff and exact file inventory remain inside this allowlist.
Internal developer checks compile and exercise request validation, redaction, operation allowlisting, attempt immutability and publication boundaries without creating QA-owned tests.
Direct non-Codespace CLI startup is demonstrated.
The primary checkout immutability mechanism and disposable workspace architecture are documented.
Independent contradictory QA is performed on the exact implementation head before any acceptance.
adversarialTests: Reject a missing request, unknown field, unknown operation and abbreviated SHA.
Reject origin marker, origin identity or request digest mismatch.
Classify stale targets before and after execution distinctly.
Exercise every paginated GitHub collector beyond one page.
Exercise publication below, at and above 58000 UTF-8 bytes.
Exercise crash recovery and duplicate-final-publication prevention.
Inject secret-shaped values into argv, stdout, stderr, environment and GitHub responses.
Run a mutating profile only inside the disposable workspace and prove the primary checkout unchanged.
Reject every GitHub mutation except a same-origin issue-conversation comment.
Verify self-stop is disabled for missing, wrong or ambiguous Codespace identity.
nonGoals: Generic shell execution, branch creation, commit, push, merge, release or workflow mutation.
Product, runtime, authoring, contract, kit, learner-data or governance-state changes.
Independent QA implementation or governor acceptance.
independentReview: Independent contradictory QA owns only tests/codespace_evidence/ paths authorized by issue #102.
Every implementation correction remains inside the CI/Ops allowlist and requires QA rerun on the corrected exact head.
An independent final architecture review and governor decision remain mandatory before merge.
rollback: Close the draft PR without merge or revert only the OPS-WP-003 implementation commits. Remove the minimal devcontainer hook, tools/codespace_evidence, documentation and work-package record, and revert the narrow .codespace-evidence ignore entry. No product state or data migration exists.
